About AID

AID (AI and Database) is a researcher-facing database of the Chinese standard histories, beginning with the Liaoshi. This page says who is behind it, who is in charge and whom the project thanks.

In charge

  • The project owner
    Initiated and directs the project and develops it. The name to be printed is asked of the owner (ops.owner_inbox).
